reason: B proposes the more physically plausible and directly testable intervention: controlled aging to generate coherent nanoprecipitates, with untreated controls and correlated TEM, tensile, and magnetocaloric measurements. Both proposals insufficiently specify precipitate chemistry and overextend soft-magnetic domain-wall arguments to a first-order magnetostructural transition, but A additionally assumes without sound support that 1–2 T pulsing at 400–600 K will enhance diffusion and create coherent precipitates in MnNiSi.
